doc_title: APPLICATION TO BE REGISTERED AS PROPRIETOR BY TRANSMISSION
doc_title_official: APPLICATION TO BE REGISTERED AS PROPRIETOR BY TRANSMISSION
when_used: A personal representative transmits a deceased proprietor's interest in a title to the person entitled to it under the estate.

detail_rows.label: Date of Grant of Will/Letters of Administration
Transferor as Personal Representative of the Estate of the Deceased
Transferee(s) as* Person Entitled under the Estate of the Deceased

body_text.text: The Transferor(s) as Personal Representative(s) and beneficiary of the above noted Deceased HEREBY TRANSFER(S) the interest of the Deceased in the above Title.
The Transfer is subject to the following:
The provisions of The Land Registration Act (No 3 of 2012) and The Land Act(No 6 of 2012);
The interests noted in the Register of the Title.
The Transfer is also subject to the following additional provisions,( if any):
The Transferee(s) declare that they shall hold the land as joint proprietors/as proprietors in common* in the following undivided shares:-
IN WITNESS WHEREOF the Transferor and the Transferee have signed this Transfer as a deed.

verification_heading.transferee: Verification of execution pursuant to Section 45 of the Land Registration Act

registry_block: REGISTERED and SEALED this ……………… day of ………….20…
foot_notes: Insert full name(s) registration number(s) registered office and address, as applicable.
Insert currency, amount and other consideration where applicable.
****The person attesting the signature must authenticate the coloured passport size photograph, National ID Number and Tax PIN Number.”

custom_fields.name: deceased_proprietor
custom_fields.label: Deceased proprietor
custom_fields.prompt: Full name of the deceased registered proprietor, with the registration number, registered office and address where the proprietor was a body corporate

custom_fields.name: date_of_grant
custom_fields.label: Date of the grant of will or letters of administration
custom_fields.prompt: Date the grant of probate of the will or the grant of letters of administration was issued

custom_fields.name: additional_provisions
custom_fields.label: Additional provisions the transfer is subject to
custom_fields.prompt: Any further provisions the transfer is to be subject to, or leave it out where there are none

custom_fields.name: undivided_shares
custom_fields.label: Undivided shares the transferees hold in
custom_fields.prompt: Where the transferees hold as proprietors in common, the undivided share each takes and the name it is held in favour of
